messages:
Jess (Sales): Hey team — heads up: Acme's sandbox import kept hitting 429s during a 10m run. Demo tomorrow 11am PST, need quick triage + mitigation. Account acct-ACME-42. Error body just says 'rate_limited'.

Devon (SE): On it. Which endpoint and can you paste curl + response headers? Also how many concurrent workers were they running?

Jess (Sales): embeddings endpoint. sample curl I used:
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"input\":\"...\",\"model\":\"open-embed-1\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Response headers we saw:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1799991200
Content-Type: application/json
```
Body: {\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"detail\":\"per_route_cap exceeded\"}

Maria (Infra): "per_route_cap exceeded" usually means their route-level reservation hit zero even if account-level quota still exists. Two things to check: their route reservation and token accounting for embedding batches. Can someone paste a small sample of their request pattern?

Jess (Sales): They were running 8 parallel workers, each sending ~6 small batches/s (so ~48 rps peak). The batches are 1k rows each but embeddings call is 1 request per row (so high QPS). I also attached sanitized app logs in the ticket.

Olivia (Eng): That concurrency explains it — burst + per-route window will trip before the account bucket if route has a tighter cap. Short-term: reduce parallelism or add client-side backoff. Medium-term: reserve per-route credits for the POC.

Devon (SE): For immediate mitigation I can apply a temporary per-route reservation for acct-ACME-42 on /v1/embeddings. Jess — want me to bump to 300 rps for next 24h?

Aj (Oncall): +1 from oncall. I'll apply and log it. We should also audit other routes to avoid noisy neighbors.

Jess (Sales): Please do. Demo hinges on this. Also need confirmation of what's changed (so I can notify the customer).

quota-bot: Temporary reservation applied: +200 rps to route "/v1/embeddings" for acct-ACME-42 until 1799993600. Ticket QZ-4592. :white_check_mark:

Devon (SE): Recommended client-side snippet (python) for graceful retry/backoff: 
```python
import time, random
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.embed(... )
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        backoff = (2 ** attempt) + random.random()
        time.sleep(backoff)
        continue
    break
```

Olivia (Eng): Filed follow-up to product docs: increase clarity on trial sandbox per-route defaults and add suggested concurrency guidance. PR: https://redwood.internal/runbook/quota-guidance (internal).

Maria (Infra): Also note: embeddings are counted differently in token budget vs request quota. We should add a note in the runbook about batch->per-item expansion so SEs know to expect high QPS from batched jobs.

Jess (Sales): Got the bump. I'll re-run the import now and report back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Aj (Oncall): Please ping here when import completes so I can close the temp reservation audit.

Jess (Sales): Import completed successfully at 1799991380. Demo team confirmed no more 429s.

Devon (SE): Great. Follow-ups: 1) add client retry example to SDK quickstarts, 2) SE playbook for reserving per-route credits for enterprise trials, 3) keep ticket QZ-4592 open until tomorrow for post-demo smoke tests.

Jess (Sales): Sounds good — closing this thread for now. Thanks again everyone! :rocket:
